name: rotulei
description: SaaS multi-tenant de geracao de placas de oferta para mercados

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rotulei/api && npm run build -w @rotulei/web
